criteria.statement: CLI deployment intent creation publishes a signed signer-first Nostr/ContextVM request and does not call the removed REST deployment intent endpoint.
CLI rollback publishes a signed signer-first Nostr/ContextVM request and does not call the removed REST rollback endpoint.

MCP deployment intent, rollback, approval, and rejection tools publish signer-first requests and return correlation receipts with request event id, pubkey, kind, result/status kinds, idempotency key, and accepted relay count.
MCP artifact registration publishes a signed kind 5985 ArtifactRegister request and requires at least one accepted relay before returning success.
MCP deployment/artifact semantic mutation tools fail closed when publishers are not configured instead of mutating RegistryService directly.
User-facing CLI, MCP, deployment, and artifact documentation describes signer-first mutation behavior and removed direct REST/registry fallback.
